belay.1: Walk left to a ledge at the foot of the obvious offwidth and build the anchor there from finger-size gear.
belay.2: The belay is a good stance directly above the offwidth, taking hand-size cams.
belay.3: Belay at a stance directly right of the small roof.
belay.7: Belay on the left-leaning ledge, in a small inset that takes thin cams and nuts.
belay.10: Belay in the notch between the two gendarmes, off slung or threaded blocks plus hand-size pieces.

belay.P7: The belay is on a good ledge at the top of the pitch.
